i would never hit you.
this is compromise.
this is how they treat women in my family.

---
from "things men have said to me" by the incredible @shemolrows 
via I am not a silent poet, edited by @ReubenWoolley 

#amreading #foundpoem #MeToo

Apparently he was so threatened by my laundry plans he wished me a Happy White Pride Month? Riiiight, he's also super racist. Duh. Raise your hand if you're surprised.
